items.sourceText: 1. For Apple Watch, download the SPAX app on your watch and allow SPAX to access Apple Health.

translations.zh: 1. 使用 Apple Watch 时，请在手表上下载 SPAX App，并允许 SPAX 访问 Apple Health。

items.sourceText: 2. For other devices, turn on Heart Rate Broadcast and connect in SPAX.

translations.zh: 2. 使用其他设备时，请开启心率广播，并在 SPAX 中连接。

items.sourceText: 1.Ensure that the hardware device is turned on

After the treadmill (exercise bike, elliptical machine, etc.) is powered on, Bluetooth is usually enabled by default. If you cannot find the Bluetooth device, you can try restarting the machine. (Some exercise bike devices require pedaling to power on)

translations.zh: 跑步机（室内单车、椭圆机等）通电后，蓝牙通常默认开启。如果无法找到蓝牙设备，可尝试重启机器。（部分室内单车设备需踩踏才能通电）

items.sourceText: 2.The Bluetooth on your phone is turned on
On the settings center of your phone, make sure that Bluetooth is turned on, and grant nearby device permissions or location permissions to the SPAX App.

translations.zh: 请在手机设置中心确认蓝牙已开启，并为 SPAX App 授予附近设备权限或位置权限。

items.sourceText: 3.The phone is near the hardware device
The Bluetooth signal can be interfered with by other signals. Please make sure that your phone is placed near the hardware device and close any idle nearby Bluetooth devices.

translations.zh: 蓝牙信号可能受到其他信号干扰。请确保手机靠近硬件设备，并关闭附近闲置的蓝牙设备。
